features.title: Speaker for spirits
features.text: Animists speak for apparitions, the spirits of places and ideas. They choose new spirit partners each day to gain Lore and magic.

features.title: Two ways to cast
features.text: They prepare divine spells and cast apparition spells spontaneously. Their primary apparition grants vessel focus spells.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2.5–4 → 3–4.5. Apparition spells and vessel choices enable stronger offensive builds than the divine list alone.
ratings.defense: 3 → 3. Eight HP and armor help, but standing in melee still has costs.
ratings.support: 4.5 → 4–5. Divine casting plus selected apparitions provide healing, control and party enhancements.
ratings.utility: 4.5 → 4–5. Changing apparitions changes Lore and spell access; daily choices govern the available tools.
ratings.difficulty: 4.5 → 4.5. Track prepared spells, apparition spells, vessel effects and daily spirit choices.
